text:
Noah: Heads-up: packaging kickoff for private deploys tomorrow. Need to align on upgrade lanes and customer-managed networking expectations.
Priya: Field needs a clear 'non-disruptive upgrade' promise. Customers will block if IPs move.
Lena: We should surface two distinct installer modes: 'vpc-managed' (online, quickstart) and 'airgap-bundle' (offline, validated).
Omar: Ops constraint: we cannot rely on customers to change inbound route policies. Peering acceptance must be manual. We should provide scripts and a verification endpoint.
Priya: Pilot asks: a minimal preflight output that NetOps can hand to customers as a checklist. Also need a one-page security note for SOC teams.
Noah: Suggest launch criteria for alpha: successful install + upgrade on 2 pilot customers in different cloud providers, preflight tooling present, and rollback validated.
Lena: Dev note: we'll need migration tests for the auth tokens and license binding when customers upgrade across minor versions.
Omar: I'll create the net-owner checklist and a small playbook for rollback.
Priya: Also, ensure the consent flow for network changes is captured in the installer prompts.
build-bot: CI notification: created pipeline redwood/private-deploy-packaging-alpha with smoke tests.
Noah: Good. We'll iterate on scope after pilots.
